answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the oasis of a task receipt, and the copper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
